view_frame: The drawing presents a TOP view in the XY plane and a SECTION view in the XZ plane. The world axes are defined as: X is the width (60 mm), Y is the depth (40 mm), and Z is the height (20 mm). The origin (0,0,0) is located at the bottom-left-front corner of the tray's outer envelope.

features.placement: Centered at (30, 20) in XY. Extruded from Z=0 to Z=20. The profile consists of straight segments at X=0, X=60, Y=0, Y=40 connected by R6 fillets at the four corners.
features.evidence: Top view shows outer boundary with dimensions 60 and 40. Text notes 'Outside: 60 x 40 x 20' and 'Outer vertical corners: R6'. Section view shows height 20.

features.placement: Centered at (30, 20) in XY. Extruded from Z=3 to Z=20. The profile is offset inward by 3 mm from the outer solid. Straight segments at X=3, X=57, Y=3, Y=37. Corner fillets are R3 (Outer R6 - Thickness 3).
features.evidence: Top view shows inner boundary. Section view shows 'EMPTY' interior with floor and walls. User clarification answer specifies uniform thickness of 3 mm.

connections: tray_cavity is subtracted from tray_outer_solid to form the final watertight tray geometry.
edit_rules: Changing the uniform thickness parameter updates the inner profile dimensions (length, width, corner radius) and the cavity start Z coordinate simultaneously.
Changing the outer dimensions (60, 40, 20) updates the outer profile and shifts the inner profile to maintain the specified uniform thickness.
Changing the outer corner radius (R6) updates the inner corner radius to (Outer Radius - Thickness).
